text_block_list.text:
Well, she's had a string of losses lately, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Gotta notch a win right around here~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I didn't have that, I wouldn't be 
talking about winning in the first place, 
now would I?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's win this and get some 
momentum going!
